Form No. 3
G.M.P. 11/24.

Shanghai Municipal Police. （印：整 28）

Intelligence Office Station.
September 18, 1925.

REPORT ON Soviet Documents.

Made by O. D. I. Givens. Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence

Sir,

I beg to report that on August 15, I accompanied
Mr. Maitland to the rooms of a Russian masseuse at No. 435
Avenue Joffre where we were permitted to examine a document in
Russian which purported to be a letter from Karahan to a Japanese
named Kawakami. A Russian speaking friend, who accompanied
Mr. Maitland, made a translation of the letter, and a copy of this
is attached herewith. The letter bore a stamp on the lower
left hand corner which contained the word, "Peking", the letters
R. K. P. (Russian Communists Party) and the letters U.S.S.R.
The letter was written on paper 10" X 8" which was impressed with
the watermark "Holland Linen". Mr. Maitland has since informed
me that he has spoken to Dr. Blackburn about this matter, and that
the latter told him that letters written on similar paper and
bearing a similar chop, which came into his possession, were found
to be forgeries. The number of the telephone at No. 435 Avenue
Joffre is W.3013.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
O. D. I. Givens
O. D. I.

D. C. I.
